title: THC Cultivation Foundations Certificate
publicDescription: This THC Academy credential recognizes successful completion of the approved Cultivation Foundations curriculum and demonstrated foundational knowledge across twelve cultivation domains: plant biology, environment and VPD, lighting, water quality and irrigation, root-zone management, nutrition, integrated pest management, propagation, canopy development, flowering, postharvest quality, and genetics. The credential emphasizes evidence-based reasoning, measurement, traceable records, and the ability to distinguish observation from unsupported conclusions.
intendedAudience: Entry-level cultivation technicians and cultivation support staff
Learners preparing for THC Cultivation Technician I
Adult learners seeking a formal foundation in evidence-based cannabis cultivation science

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Learners complete a randomized 60-item final assessment mapped evenly across the twelve Foundations competencies, with five scored items per competency and reference-backed item content.
assessmentModel.passingStandard: A minimum score of 80 percent is required on the approved Foundations final assessment, in addition to a completed course record for the current credentialed course version.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: The final assessment permits up to three attempts with a 24-hour cooldown between attempts so remediation can occur before another scored attempt.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Credential eligibility requires a completed THC Cultivation Foundations course record and a passing result for ASSESS-CULT-FOUNDATIONS-FINAL-001. The issued record preserves credential and course version information for verification.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: This foundational credential primarily verifies academic and applied decision-making knowledge. Hands-on occupational performance is assessed more extensively in the THC Cultivation Technician credentials.

employmentUse: Evidence of structured foundational cultivation education for entry-level hiring, onboarding, or internal development decisions.
Prerequisite knowledge credential for progression into THC Cultivation Technician I and more advanced Academy pathways.
A verifiable record that the learner met the Academy passing standard across the defined Foundations competency domains.

standardsAlignment.relationship: Program design is benchmarked to publicly described cannabis/hemp certificate-program quality practices.
standardsAlignment.claim: Alignment informs instructional design, assessment, records, and quality-system structure; it is not a claim that this credential has been accredited to ASTM D8403-21.

standardsAlignment.relationship: Program design is benchmarked to publicly described assessment-based certificate-program practices.
standardsAlignment.claim: Alignment informs learning-outcome assessment, passing standards, certificate controls, and continuous improvement; external accreditation is a separate status.

limitations: This is a THC Academy credential and does not by itself constitute a state, federal, or local occupational or cannabis license.
The credential does not claim ANAB, ANSI, ISO, ASTM, government, college, or university accreditation unless a separate accreditation record explicitly states otherwise.
Employers and jurisdictions may require additional role-specific training, facility authorization, regulated-worker credentials, or supervised performance evidence.
